Fragmentum ex homiliis in Acta apostolorum
ΕΚ ΤΩΝ ΩΡΙΓΕΝΟΥΣ ΕΙΣ ΤΑΣ ΠΡΑΞΕΙΣ ΤΩΝ ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΩΝ.
Ἐκ τῆς εἰς τὰς Πράξεις ὁμιλίας δʹ.
14.829 Ἔδει πληρωθῆναι τὴν Γραφὴν, ἣν προεῖπε τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον διὰ στόματος
∆αυῒδ περὶ Ἰούδα· 14.832 ἐν ᾧ ψαλμῷ τὰ περὶ τοῦ Ἰούδα γέγραπται. Εἴποι τις ἂν, ὅτι
οὐ τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον λαλεῖ· σαφῶς γὰρ τοῦ Σωτῆρός εἰσιν οἱ λόγοι λέγοντος· Ὁ
Θεὸς, τὴν αἴνεσίν μου μὴ παρασιωπήσης· ὅτι στόμα ἁμαρτωλοῦ, καὶ στόμα δολίου,
ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἠνοίχθη· καὶ τὰ ἑξῆς ἕως· Καὶ τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτοῦ λάβοι ἕτερος. Πῶς οὖν, εἰ
ὁ Σωτήρ ἐστιν ὁ ταῦτα λέγων, φησὶν ὁ Πέτρος· Ἔδει πληρωθῆναι τὴν Γραφὴν, ἣν
pass_a_gloss: It was necessary for the Scripture to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas; in which psalm the things concerning Judas have been written. Someone might say that it is not the Holy Spirit who speaks; for clearly the words are the Savior's, saying: O God, do not keep silent at my praise; because a mouth of a sinner and a mouth of a deceitful one was opened against me; and the things following until: And let another take his oversight. How then, if the Savior is the one saying these things, does Peter say: It was necessary for the Scripture to be fulfilled, which…
pass_b_english: [[Scripture had to be fulfilled >> Bible:Acts 1:16]] which the Holy Spirit foretold through David's mouth concerning Judas—the psalm in which the things about Judas are written.

Someone might object that it is not the Holy Spirit speaking, since the words are plainly the Savior's: "[[O God, do not keep silent at my praise; for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful have opened against me >> Bible:Psalm 109:1-2]]," and so on through "[[let another take his office >> Bible:Psalm 109:8]]."
How then, if the Savior is the speaker, does Peter say that Scripture had to be fulfilled which…
